review_locator: PMCID:PMC11717358, Exploring neuroglial signaling: diversity of molecules implicated in microglia-to-astrocyte neuroimmune communication; PMCID:PMC4618768, Control of autoimmune CNS inflammation by astrocytes
primary_title: Human Astrocytes: Secretome Profiles of Cytokines and Chemokines
decision_basis: The reviews identify IL-1beta plus TNF as a validated astrocyte inflammatory stimulus; the cited primary protein-secretome study detects a marked increase in G-CSF/CSF3 in conditioned medium from highly purified human astrocytes.
limitations_preserved: Combined-input secreted-protein output only; preserve human astrocyte and protein-array context, distinguish CSF3 release from transcript inference and later CSF3R signaling, and do not infer traumatic-SCI weighting.
